lines: That was stale enough to leave on the shelf.
I have seen bad meat with more sense than that.
Careful. Even salt looks softer than your manners right now.
I have seen broken meat with better instincts than you.
You have all the warmth of cold grease.
I have trimmed better judgment off a bad cut.
Your manners spoiled before the meat did.
Careful. Even a dull knife knows when to stay quiet.
You bring the room down like smoke in a low ceiling.
I have seen bones with more flexibility than your thinking.
That remark was undercooked and still somehow burned.
You stand there like a bad smell looking for credit.
I would season that opinion, but waste bothers me.
You have the confidence of stew nobody tasted first.
A spoiled ham has better timing than you.
I could carve sense into a roast before finding it in you.
Even the smoke is trying to leave after that.
You are proof that sharp tools do not make sharp minds.
That was a poor cut of thought.
Even stale meat has the sense to stay quiet.
I have carved gristle with more grace than you brought here.
I have seen bad meat with more sense than that.
Careful. Even salt looks softer than your manners right now.
A chipped cleaver is easier company than you are today.
Wipe your feet before the whole road ends up beside my block.
Do not put those hands near food you did not help prepare.
Your voice is carrying farther than your good sense.
The smokehouse already has enough unpleasant smells.
Ask properly or find someone with time for your performance.
I am holding a knife and still showing more restraint than you.
You arrived empty-handed and somehow brought extra trouble.
Keep your excuses short. The meat will not wait through them.
The village has plenty of pens if you insist on acting wild.
I have work on this table that deserves better company.
Try that demand again after you remember how people speak to each other.
Being loud will not move you to the front of the line.
Even the smoker knows when to stop blowing hot air.
Leave the hooks alone and take your attitude with you.
Come back after your temper has cooled and your boots are clean.
I will not waste daylight trimming the nonsense out of that story.
